# Data Directory

This directory stores datasets used in this project. Note that large CSV files are ignored via `.gitignore` to maintain a lightweight repository.

* `heavy_metal_oxides.csv`: Raw dataset retrieved from the Materials Project API (Generated by Notebook 01).
* `featurized_data.csv`: Processed dataset containing 132 MAGPIE features and density (Generated by Notebook 02).

**Data Source:** External data fetched dynamically via `mp-api`.
